items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: On the jam session in Japan. And Benny, I played only one chorus of improvisation. And Benny says, “oh, one more, one more time.”

ctx.x: Many audiences said Eiji’s very rich, a rich man. But I don’t have money, only potatoes, onions, every day.
In 1957, did you get to play with Benny Goodman?

Yes. On the jam session in Japan. And Benny, I played only one chorus of improvisation. And Benny says, “oh, one more, one more time.” And I played a chorus. And I played with many other American musicians, and I’m so excited. And I thought about, my music, okay.
